notes.title: Playtest Hotfix 02
notes.notes:
Ciao Pizza Managers!




The playtests are in full swing by now. Thank you to everyone involved for your participation, feedback and the filled out forms. You’re really making a difference and helping us out tremendously! 



Based on your comments and suggestions we have a new set of improvements, which by the time you read this, should be live. Please update your game!

Patch notes[hr][/hr]New functionality and improvements
added a highlight to all work stations in the tutorial.

added a new hint to the Emotion Wheel.

Added new actions to the Emotion Wheel - ask the customer to leave the restaurant, ask the client for additional time. 

The telephone booth now shows a “Available in the full release” prompt.

Added a shopping cart and a notification while shopping. After leaving the store, the player receives more time to make the payment.


Balance
Decreased the frequency of rivals sabotaging the restaurant.

Increased the clients’ waiting time to be served.


Input
Changed the gamepad mapping scheme - the run action has been moved to the left stick button.


UI/UX
The naming conventions in the game have been standardized and improved.


System
Fixed a few minor bugs and made general improvements to the game’s stability
[hr][/hr]

We’re also happy to announce that we are expanding the pool of participants for the playtests. Please check your emails.

This will probably be the last group of people, who will receive an invitation. If you haven’t been selected this time, please be patient for future opportunities.



After playing the game, please remember to fill out the form, available directly from the game’s main menu. Your feedback will shape the direction of our future work, so consider using a few minutes of your time to fill it out - we will appreciate it immensely! 



If you haven’t done so already, please consider joining our Discord server, where you will find other like-minded pizza enthusiasts. It’s also a great place to talk with us directly.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/ca8a78e67837c7bdc71acdec23388ed67505acc4.png"]



See you at the table!

The Pizza Slice team

notes.title: Playtest Hotfix 01
notes.notes:
Ciao Pizza Managers!




The first lucky people are now able to download and launch the game. This also means, we have received the initial reports of bugs and issues. Some of them are more immediate, hence the quick hotfix. 


Patch Notes
Fixed the grayed out button in the main menu screen.

Fixed an issue in which loading a save game would spawn the player in the back corner of the pantry.

Fixed an issue where the food cleaning tutorial would not display in certain circumstances.

Fixed minor issues regarding loading save games.

Improved the animations displayed during the loading screen.



[img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//38508634/0f10343f09258a89fc3868e5b3cd2df9f3cb118b.png"]
[hr][/hr]


We are aware of other bugs, including some translation issues, which we will be addressing in the near future. Please continue to send your findings and suggestions - we read them all and they are extremely helpful. Also don’t forget to fill out the form after you’ve experienced the game.



We will be opening another round of admissions for the playtest very soon, so please check your email inboxes regularly.



We also invite everyone to join our Discord server, where we have a dedicated channel for active playtesters - it's the best way to reach out to us directly.



[img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//38508634/ca8a78e67837c7bdc71acdec23388ed67505acc4.png"]



Thank you for your support, it means the world to us! 



See you at the table!

The Pizza Slice Team
